description: This is a test class for the DoubleRange class, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of various methods of DoubleRange such as equals, compareTo, contains, toString, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: DoubleRangeTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the DoubleRange class covering its various methods and behaviors.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueForTheSameObjectTypeAndFalseForDifferentTypeObjects
methods.description: Tests the equals method to ensure it returns true when comparing two DoubleRange objects with the same data and false when comparing with a different object type.

methods.name: DoubleRange_shouldReturnNullLowAndHighIfAccessorsAreNotCalled
methods.description: Verifies that getHigh() and getLow() return null if the DoubleRange was initialized with the default constructor and accessors haven't been called.

methods.name: DoubleRange_shouldReturnInfiniteLowAndHighIfCalledWithNullParameters
methods.description: Checks that the range returns positive and negative infinity for high and low respectively when initialized with null parameters.

methods.name: getHigh_shouldReturnCorrectValueOfHighIfHighWasSetPreviously
methods.description: Verifies getHigh() returns the correct value after setting high.

methods.name: getHigh_shouldReturnPositiveInfinityIfHighWasNotSetPreviously
methods.description: Tests that getHigh() returns positive infinity if high wasn't set explicitly.

methods.name: setHigh_shouldSetHighToPositiveInfinityOnNullParameter
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to setHigh() sets the high boundary to positive infinity.

methods.name: setHigh_shouldCauseHighToHaveTheSetValue
methods.description: Tests that setHigh() correctly assigns a specific value to the high boundary.

methods.name: getLow_shouldReturnCorrectValueOfLowIfLowWasSetPreviously
methods.description: Checks that getLow() returns the correct value after setting low.

methods.name: getLow_shouldReturnNegativeInfinityIfLowWasNotSetPreviously
methods.description: Verifies getLow() defaults to negative infinity when not explicitly set.

methods.name: setLow_shouldSetLowToNegativeInfinityOnNullParameter
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to setLow() sets the low boundary to negative infinity.

methods.name: setLow_shouldCauseLowToHaveTheSetValue
methods.description: Tests that setLow() correctly assigns a specific value to the low boundary.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPlus1IfThisLowIsGreaterThanOtherLow
methods.description: Verifies compareTo returns 1 when this range's low is greater than the other's.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnMinusOneIfThisLowIsLowerThanOtherLow
methods.description: Checks compareTo returns -1 when this range's low is less than the other's.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnZeroIfBothLowsAndBothHighsAreEqual
methods.description: Verifies compareTo returns 0 when both ranges are equal.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPlusOneIfBothLowsAreEqualButOtherHighIsGreaterThanThisHigh
methods.description: Tests compareTo when lows are equal but highs differ, expecting 1 if other's high is greater.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnMinusOneIfBothLowsAreEqualButOtherHighIsLessThanThisHigh
methods.description: Tests compareTo when lows are equal but this high is greater than other's, expecting -1.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturn1IfThisRangeIsWiderThanOtherRange
methods.description: Verifies compareTo returns 1 when this range's high is wider than the other's.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnTrueIfParameterIsInRange
methods.description: Confirms that contains() returns true for a value within the range.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnFalseIfParameterIsNotInRange
methods.description: Ensures that contains() returns false for a value outside the range.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnFalseIfParameterIsEqualToHigh
methods.description: Tests that contains() is exclusive of the high boundary.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnTrueIfParameterIsEqualToLow
methods.description: Confirms that contains() includes the low boundary.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnFalseIfParameterIsLowerThanLow
methods.description: Verifies that contains() returns false for values less than the low boundary.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintTheRangeIfHighAndLowAreNotNullAndNotInfinite
methods.description: Checks that toString() correctly prints the range when boundaries are finite.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyLowIfLowIsInfinite
methods.description: Ensures toString() omits the low boundary if it is infinite.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyStringIfLowAndHighAreInfinite
methods.description: Verifies that toString() returns an empty string if both boundaries are infinite.

methods.name: hashCode_shouldReturnTheSameHashCodeForObjectsRepresentingTheSameInterval
methods.description: Ensures that hashCode() returns consistent values for equal range objects.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyStringIfLowAndHighAreNull
methods.description: Checks that toString() returns an empty string if boundaries are null.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyLowIfLowIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that toString() omits the low boundary if it is null.
